Class StructuredOutputSchemas

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.langchain4j.jsonschema.StructuredOutputSchemas
@Singleton @Internal @Requires(property="langchain4j.structured-output.enabled",notEquals="false",defaultValue="true") @Requires(beans=StructuredOutputSchemaProvider.class) public final class StructuredOutputSchemas extends Object
Configures the AI services and agents whose methods return a type with a schema supplied by a StructuredOutputSchemaProvider (by default, a type annotated with io.micronaut.jsonschema.JsonSchema), so that this schema is sent to the chat model as the structured output format.

Methods returning T, List<T> or Set<T>, optionally wrapped in Result, CompletableFuture or CompletionStage, are supported. LangChain4j still decides when a response format is sent and parses the response; only the schema is replaced.
